skills.name: Mystic Projectile
skills.description: Gord conjures a Mystic Orb that bounces in the target direction and explodes on the first enemy hit, dealing 270<font color='#27C0C7'>( +80% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color='#3B69FF'>(Magic Damage)</font> to enemies in the area, while stunning them and revealing their locations for 1s.
skills.tips: Skill 1 usahakan musuh terkena tepat dari lingkaran bola Gord karena ketika tepat musuh akan terkena Stun dan Damage lebih, selalu arahkan kemana musuh akan berada karena musuh juga akan selalu bergerak.

skills.name: Mystic Injunction
skills.description: Gord creates an energy field in the target area, dealing 55<font color='#27C0C7'>( +16% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color='#3B69FF'>(Magic Damage)</font> every 0.3s to enemies within (up to 13 times).
skills.tips: Gunakan skill ini selain untuk mencicil HP lawan juga bisa dengan cepat membuat Lane-mu bersih dari Creep lawan.

skills.name: Mystic Gush
skills.description:
Gord unleashes an energy beam in the target direction, dealing 110<font color='#27C0C7'>( +32% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color='#3B69FF'>(Magic Damage)</font> to enemies hit every 0.2s (up to 16 times).
The direction of the beam can be adjusted using the Joystick.
skills.tips: Berlatihlah agar Skill ini mengenai semua lawan, karena ketika War kita bisa menggunakannya untuk mencicil HP lawan atau juga membersihkan Lane. Namun gunakan dengan bijak dan ketika memang Skill harus di Cancel, maka kamu dapat meng-cancel Ulti dengan meng-klik Skill 3 lagi.

skills.name: Mystic Favor
skills.description: After Gord hits an enemy 4 times with Basic Attacks or skills within a short period of time, the next attack on the target will deal an additional 140<font color='#27C0C7'>( +60% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color='#E5CB19'>(True Damage)</font> and slow them by 20% for 1s (the slow effect stacks up to 2 times).
skills.tips: Selalu berlatih agar semua Skill dapat pas mengenai lawan, meskipun sulit namun Gord adalah Hero berbahaya yang dapat memberikan Damage terbesar pada musuh.

items.name: Glowing Wand
items.des: Unique Passive - Scorch: Burn targets for 3s, dealing Magic Damage equal to 1.5% of the target's Max HP per second.

items.name: Demon Boots
items.des: Unique Passive - Mysticism: Getting a kill or assist on an enemy Minion will restore 4% Mana. (An assist occurs when a Minion dies within 2s after taking damage from the hero.)

items.name: Ice Queen Wand
items.des: Unique Passive - Ice Bound: When a skill deals damage to an enemy hero, it will also slow them by 10% for 2s (stacks up to 3 times). This effect has a 1s cooldown.

items.name: Genius Wand
items.des: Unique Passive - Magic: Dealing Magic Damage to enemy heroes will reduce their Magic Defense by 3-7 (scales with level) for 2s. Stacks up to 3 times.

items.name: Holy Crystal
items.des: Unique Passive - Mystery: Gains 21%-35% extra Magic Power (scales with level).

items.name: Blood Wings
items.des: Unique Passive - Guard: Gains a shield equal to 200% of Magic Power. The shield will regenerate 20s after being damaged, and grants 30 Movement Speed while it lasts.

builds.tips: Beli 1/2 Magic Necklace di awal game, lalu membeli :    - Magic Shoes    Selain menambah kecepatan pada hero juga mendapatkan Cooldown Reduction sebesar 10%.    - Enchanted Talisman   Cooldown sebesar 20% serta Magic Power, HP serta Regen 10% Mana setiap 10 detik.    - Holy Crystal    Memiliki Magic Power yang besar dan meningkatkan Magic Power di pasif uniknya.    - Glowing Wand   Menambahkan Magic Power, Magic Penetration serta Cooldown Reduction dan juga pasif uniknya menambahkan Magic Damage.    - Lighting Truncheon  Menambahkan Magic Power, Mana Regen, serta pasif uniknya yang membuat Damage Ulti Gord semakin besar.    - Immortality Karena menambah Magic Resist dan juga HP yang besar serta membuat Gord hidup kembali dengan HP yang sedikit setelah mati.
